name: crunch-republic-root
description: Root package runner for MERN QR Menu SaaS MVP

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.preview: concurrently "npm run dev-backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.build-and-preview: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run preview
